subject.title: Feature Request: Add Skill Priority Configuration

question: Should OpenClaw add a first-class skill priority/ordering contract, and if so should it live in canonical `openclaw.json` skill config rather than a separate sidecar file?
rationale: This changes model-facing session context, public config schema, CLI surface, prompt-cache stability, and truncation behavior, so automation should not choose the permanent API shape without maintainer intent.

options.title: Add canonical priority config
options.body: Add a narrowly scoped `skills` ordering contract to the existing config/schema/docs and apply it only after current eligibility and agent filters are resolved.

options.title: Limit to truncation visibility
options.body: Keep explicit priority out of core for now and handle only omitted-skill discovery through the existing truncation work.

options.title: Defer as broader smart indexing
options.body: Leave this issue parked until maintainers decide a larger skill-search or lazy-loading architecture such as https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/89361.

recommendation.title: Add canonical priority config
recommendation.body: Add a narrowly scoped `skills` ordering contract to the existing config/schema/docs and apply it only after current eligibility and agent filters are resolved.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has recent history on the skills CLI and per-skill config surface, which are central to the API decision.
